entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A human planeswalker and mind-mage from Vryn who founded the Gatewatch, became the Living Guildpact, was compleated, and died after his Echoverse plan failed.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The aspect of Jace left after his other selves were excised, a cold, empathy-less version who tries to overwrite the Multiverse with the Echoverse.

entities.name: The Detective
entities.description: An aspect of Jace as a member of the Gatewatch, who helps the planeswalkers plot against the Theorist.

entities.name: Specter of Jace Beleren
entities.description: The ghostly version of Jace after his death, who retains planeswalking but only hears ghosts and casts illusions in mirrors.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A living being Jace created, composed of his best qualities, who is later made a planeswalker by his spark.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A sphinx and mage of Vryn who takes Jace as apprentice, lies about his spark, and has his mind destroyed by Jace.

entities.name: Gav Beleren
entities.description: Jace's father, who sought Alhammarret's help with his son.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother and a healer on Vryn who stabilizes him and Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who finds amnesiac Jace on Ixalan, becomes his lover, is compleated, and helps stop the Theorist.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker and master of the Infinite Consortium who tortures Jace and is mind-wiped by him.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who crushes Jace's mind on Amonkhet and is later imprisoned by Ugin.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who has a romance with Jace, betrays him to the Consortium, and later joins the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: A Selesnya guild leader and friend of Jace who has her memories of planeswalkers erased at her request.

entities.name: Kallist Rhoka
entities.description: A blademaster who looks like Jace and whose body Jace takes after absorbing his mind failed.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who helps defeat Sarkhan with Jace and is a founding Gatewatch member.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker cursed by the Chain Veil, whom Jace stops by implanting a hedron.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire ruin-sage of Zendikar who guides Jace to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker defeated by Jace and Chandra at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet planeswalker who forces Jace to reveal himself and later works with him.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who attracts Jace's attention when Jace mentally connects with him.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who recruits Jace for the Battle for Zendikar and sacrifices himself for Liliana.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elven planeswalker and Gatewatch member who clashes with Jace over the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who reignites his spark and tortures Jace, Gideon and Nissa.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon who berates Jace for killing the Eldrazi and later takes Bolas to the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who cures Jace's madness on Innistrad and helps seal Emrakul.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who destroys Avacyn, his creation.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: An ancient Azorius parun on Ixalan whom Jace sentences to be caretaker of Useless Island.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir shapeshifter who manipulates the maze-runners and saves Jace from Exava.

entities.name: Mirko Vosk
entities.description: A Dimir vampire who wounds Emmara and probes Jace's mind.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: A Rakdos blood witch who hunts Jace.

entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: A Gruul ogre whom Jace fights and persuades to let him search his mind.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius lawmage who arrests Jace and helps maintain the guildpact office.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: An Azorius leader who judges Jace and is later murdered by Vraska.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov Envoy who fights Emmara and Jace in the maze.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon on Amonkhet whom Liliana kills with Jace's help.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Kor planeswalker who seeks to restore the Makindi Empire on Zendikar and is later compleated.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A Kor warrior who guides Jace to the Singing City.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who impales Jace with her Halo-infused blade and seizes the Sylex.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who lets Jace witness the Sylex detonation and tries to stop him.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights Jace on New Phyrexia and Duskmourn.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A Fomori child found in a vault on Thunder Junction, adopted by Jace and Vraska.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae planeswalker hired by Jace, disguised as Ashiok, to find the vault key.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A demon on Duskmourn who captures Loot.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: A Kaladeshi leader Jace uses to sabotage the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who meets Jace and Vraska in the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk friend of Gideon who travels with Jace to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights alongside the Gatewatch at Zendikar.

entities.name: Marit Lage
entities.description: A goddess of the Hospitallers of the Frozen Heart who homes in on Jace's telepathy.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and goes to Hexhaven to confront the Theorist.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader whose planar shield incapacitates the Gatewatch's strike team.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: The Oracle of Arcavios kidnapped by Tam and killed by her own hand, which exposes the Theorist to the knowledge of creation.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A great detective whose magic Jace copies after knocking him out.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch Jace tricks into helping him while disguised as Ashiok.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who warps time around Liliana in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who volunteers with Jace to assassinate Liliana.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane where he was born.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city plane where Jace becomes the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane of the Eldrazi, where the Gatewatch forms.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Emrakul is sealed in the moon.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas crushes Jace's mind.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where amnesiac Jace is stranded and found by Vraska.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch meets the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane where Jace is compleated.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane with an ancient vault holding Loot.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: The realm where Jace tries to remake reality.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The alternate reality Jace creates as a world free of suffering.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane where Loot is captured by Valgavoth.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Jace and Vraska rest before the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane where Jace halts Garruk's curse.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The Zendikari chamber where Jace and Chandra defeat Sarkhan.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A Zendikari city attacked by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: The island where Azor is made caretaker.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: A Zendikari ruin where Nahiri collects power.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: The endpoint of the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The Echoverse academy of the Theorist on the mirror Arcavios.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: The organization led by Tezzeret that Jace joins.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers Jace founds.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Cosmic horrors including Ulamog, Kozilek and Emrakul.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan trapped and destroyed by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan destroyed by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The third Eldrazi titan, sealed in Innistrad's moon.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad created and destroyed by Sorin.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The doomsday device Jace tries to activate on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The invasion tree on New Phyrexia that the Sylex is meant to deactivate.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: Ugin's gem that Jace steals.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: The artifact cursing Garruk.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The mediator title Jace receives from the Bailiff.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: A spell that can destroy the guilty, delivered by the Bailiff.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The Phyrexian transformation Jace undergoes.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The Ravnica battle against Bolas.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on the Multiverse.

events.summary: Alhammarret takes Jace as an apprentice at thirteen.
events.quote: Alhammarret took Jace from his father and allowed him to become his apprentice at age thirteen.

events.summary: Jace learns that his spark ignited a year earlier and that Alhammarret lied to him.
events.quote: He discovered that his spark had ignited over a year ago, dipping him into the Blind Eternities only for a moment.

events.summary: Jace destroys Alhammarret's mind in rage.
events.quote: He slipped into Alhammarret's mind and unleashed all of his rage and pain at once, destroying his master's mind.

events.summary: Jace erases his own memories of what he had done.
events.quote: Jace erased his memories so that he would never have to see his teacher's face again

events.summary: In the revised origin, Alhammarret is revealed as a sphinx arbitrating between Vryn's warring factions.
events.quote: Alhammarret was revealed to be a sphinx who arbitrated between the two warring factions of Vryn.

events.summary: Jace destroys the sphinx's mind in a telepathic duel and accidentally planeswalks to Ravnica.
events.quote: forced Jace to accidentally planeswalk away, landing himself in the streets of Ravnica

events.summary: Jace agrees to join Tezzeret's Infinite Consortium.
events.quote: Jace agreed and began training with Tezzeret to hone his telepathy for the Consortium's use.

events.summary: Jace is sent to Thunder Junction to investigate an ancient vault and senses a child inside.
events.quote: Jace was sent to the abandoned plane of Thunder Junction to investigate the contents of an ancient vault

events.summary: Tezzeret beats Jace after a failed mission to Kamigawa.
events.quote: Tezzeret savagely beats Jace for failing

events.summary: Bolas breaks through Jace's defenses at a meeting with Tezzeret.
events.quote: Jace's defenses, which were untested to begin with, failed when Bolas struck.

events.summary: Liliana reveals Jace's hiding place to the Consortium.
events.quote: Without Jace's knowledge, and with a heavy heart, Liliana revealed where Jace and Kallist had settled to the Consortium.

events.summary: Jace switches bodies with Kallist after failing to absorb his mind.
events.quote: Jace tried to absorb Kallist's mind and switched bodies with the assassin when it failed.

events.summary: Jace wipes Tezzeret's mind, causing the Fall of the Infinite Consortium.
events.quote: Jace wiping Tezzeret's mind clean, effectively causing the Fall of the Infinite Consortium

events.summary: Jace tracks Chandra to retrieve the Dragon Scroll and erase her memory of it.
events.quote: his mission was to erase all memories of it from the pyromancer's mind

events.summary: Jace rips the Eye of Ugin's location from Anowon's mind.
events.quote: Jace ripped the information he sought from the vampire's mind

events.summary: Jace and Chandra defeat Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: With it, the pair defeated Sarkhan, knocking the entire group unconscious.

events.summary: Jace makes a mental connection with Niv-Mizzet and learns the answers about the maze.
events.quote: making a mental connection with the Firemind

events.summary: Jace erases six months of his memory.
events.quote: even going so far as to erase the memories of six months' worth of work

events.summary: Ral Zarek forces Jace to reveal he is a planeswalker to Emmara.
events.quote: Ral forced Jace to reveal his identity to Emmara

events.summary: Jace links the maze-runners' minds and is declared the new Guildpact by the Bailiff.
events.quote: Jace connected their ten minds to prevent any from casting the verdict.

events.summary: The Bailiff declares Jace the new Guildpact.
events.quote: the Bailiff had declared Jace the new Guildpact

events.summary: At her request Jace erases Emmara's memories of other worlds and planeswalkers.
events.quote: Regretfully, Jace granted her request.

events.summary: Jace neutralizes Vraska, who tried to control the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Jace neutralized Vraska for the moment

events.summary: Jace halts Garruk's chain veil curse by implanting a hedron in him.
events.quote: Jace succeeded in implanting the hedron in Garruk and halting the curse of the chain veil.

events.summary: Gideon decides to recruit Jace for the Battle for Zendikar.
events.quote: he decided to recruit the master of leylines himself: Jace.

events.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog.
events.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

events.summary: Ob Nixilis frees Kozilek and reignites his spark.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis used his newfound power to coax the second Eldrazi Titan, Kozilek, from its hiding spot

events.summary: Ob Nixilis captures and tortures Gideon, Jace and Nissa.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis then took Gideon, Jace, and Nissa prisoner, took them to a cave, and tortured them.

events.summary: Chandra frees her friends and scares Ob Nixilis away.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar showed up and freed her friends.

events.summary: Jace, Gideon, Chandra and Nissa swear an oath, forming the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

events.summary: Ulamog and Kozilek are incinerated by Chandra's flames channeled through Nissa.
events.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

events.summary: Ugin berates Jace and his friends for killing the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Jace and his friends were berated by Ugin for killing the ancient creatures.

events.summary: Liliana snaps Jace out of the cryptoliths' influence.
events.quote: bringing Jace back to his senses by stating that she didn't wish to hurt him anymore

events.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn and Emrakul arrives.
events.quote: Sorin Markov showed up and destroyed his creation.

events.summary: Jace, Nissa and Tamiyo trap Emrakul in Innistrad's moon.
events.quote: Jace combined forces with Nissa and Tamiyo to trap Emrakul in Innistrad's moon

events.summary: Tamiyo reveals that Emrakul overtook her and wanted to be sealed.
events.quote: Tamiyo revealed that she had been overtaken by Emrakul when she had cast the second spell

events.summary: Jace recommends going straight to Amonkhet to confront Bolas.
events.quote: Jace recommended traveling directly to the plane

events.summary: Jace helps Liliana kill Razaketh.
events.quote: he summoned illusions to distract the demon and allowed Liliana to kill the demon.

events.summary: Bolas crushes Jace's mind and Jace planeswalks away to avoid mind-death.
events.quote: Jace's mind was crushed, and he instinctively planeswalked away to avoid mind-death.

events.summary: Jace arrives on Ixalan with no memory.
events.quote: When he arrived he had no memory of who or what he was.

events.summary: Vraska's crew fishes Jace out of the sea.
events.quote: After several days, he was fished up by Vraska and her crew.

events.summary: Jace's memories partly return after he falls into the Golden City's waters.
events.quote: To Vraska's horror, the shock caused Jace's memories to partially return.

events.summary: Jace sentences Azor to be caretaker of Useless Island.
events.quote: he sentenced Azor to be the caretaker of Useless Island

events.summary: Vraska asks Jace to remove her memories of him.
events.quote: Vraska asked Jace to temporarily remove her memories of him.

events.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien volunteer to assassinate Liliana.
events.quote: Jace, Jaya, Teferi, and Vivien volunteered to assassinate Liliana.

events.summary: Jace witnesses Gideon sacrificing his life to save Liliana.
events.quote: Jace witnessed Gideon sacrificing his life to save Liliana.

events.summary: Jace hides that Ugin took Bolas's body.
events.quote: Jace used an illusion to hide the fact that Ugin had taken Bolas' body

events.summary: Jace and Vraska share a kiss at the celebration.
events.quote: he and Vraska finally shared a kiss

events.summary: Jace and Vraska break up after Vraska accuses him of still loving Liliana.
events.quote: They broke up after Vraska accused him of still having feelings for Liliana.

events.summary: Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and takes the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: Jace turned the tables on her and took control of her mind.

events.summary: Nissa uses the Core to flatten the Singing City and heal Zendikar.
events.quote: Jace witnessed how she flattened the Singing City into dust and restored Zendikar's soil.

events.summary: Jace organizes Ravnica's defense against New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Jace Beleren organized Ravnica 's defense against the New Phyrexian threat

events.summary: Elesh Norn's planar shield scatters and incapacitates the planeswalkers.
events.quote: Arriving on New Phyrexia, he found that the group had been partially incapacitated and scattered by a planar shield erected by Elesh Norn

events.summary: Vraska infects Jace with phyresis.
events.quote: Vraska succumbed to the Phyrexian influence and infected Jace in turn.

events.summary: Nahiri sacrifices herself to blow up Sheoldred's Coliseum.
events.quote: Nahiri, who was also infected, decided to sacrifice herself for the greater good.

events.summary: Jace prepares to activate the Sylex at Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Jace prepared to activate the Sylex

events.summary: Elspeth impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.
events.quote: impaled Jace with her Halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away

events.summary: Jace defies the oil and removes his compleation components.
events.quote: he forcefully removed the physical components of his compleation

events.summary: Jace shares a psychic defense with Vraska to shake the oil's grip.
events.quote: Jace could relay the psychic defense needed to shake the oil's grip.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska plot the rebirth of the Multiverse.
events.quote: plotted a rebirth of the Multiverse

events.summary: Vraska discovers she has lost her spark.
events.quote: Vraska discovered that she had lost her Planeswalker's spark

events.summary: Jace knocks out Alquist Proft with a lead pipe to copy his magic.
events.quote: He knocked Proft unconscious with a lead pipe

events.summary: Jace and Vraska escape with Loot as the vault collapses.
events.quote: Jace and Vraska disappeared with Loot.

events.summary: Jace abandons Kaito in a gel pit to save Vraska.
events.quote: Jace, prioritizing the others, climbed out, abandoning Kaito.

events.summary: Valgavoth captures Loot.
events.quote: he was captured by the demon Valgavoth

events.summary: Jace knocks out Chandra and recovers Loot.
events.quote: he rendered her unconscious with an overwhelming mental attack, recovering Loot

events.summary: Jace and Vraska enter the Meditation Plane through an Omenpath.
events.quote: Jace and Vraska traveled through an Omenpath to the Meditation Plane

events.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem.
events.quote: he secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole his Spirit-Gem

events.summary: Jace's attempt fails and he shatters like glass.
events.quote: he shattered like glass

events.summary: Everyone, including Bolas, flees the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: all present, including Bolas, left the Meditation Realm

events.summary: Jace rebuilds himself and begins constructing a new reality.
events.quote: He began constructing a new reality

events.summary: Jace creates Tamira as his protege.
events.quote: Tamira was designed as Jace's perfect protégé

events.summary: Jace discards dissenting parts of himself, becoming the Theorist.
events.quote: his most stubborn self refused to hear dissenting opinions

events.summary: Tam decides to stop the Theorist.
events.quote: Tam realized that the Theorist had been consumed by his conviction and was no longer capable of reason

events.summary: The Theorist has Vraska, Ajani and Chandra tossed into his mental space where the Detective finds them.
events.quote: The Theorist had the Echoverse doubles of the four planeswalkers round them up and toss them through a portal to his mental space

events.summary: Jadzi kills herself, exposing the Theorist to the knowledge of creation.
events.quote: Jadzi realized this, and with apparent conviction, grabbed his knife and fatally slashed her own throat.

events.summary: The Theorist binds the two Multiverses together.
events.quote: bind the two Multiverses together

events.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist through the heart and the aspects reunite in Jace.
events.quote: Vraska used as an opportunity to ambush him and stab him through the heart

events.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms.
events.quote: Jace died in Vraska's arms, and the last emotion he felt was happiness.

events.summary: Jace's spark flies to Tam and makes her a planeswalker.
events.quote: his spark left his body and flew across the disintegrating multiversal overlay, arriving in Tam and transforming her into a planeswalker

events.summary: Hospitallers put Jace in a coma and use his mind to draw Marit Lage toward Ravnica.
events.quote: one of the members put Jace into a coma and delivered him to the hospital

events.summary: Marit Lage plummets toward Jace at Naktamun.
events.quote: As Marit Lage finally came plummeting toward Jace

events.summary: Jace's specter retains planeswalking after his death.
events.quote: When Jace died, his specter retained the planeswalking skill.

events.summary: Tezzeret infects Jace with an etherium device.
events.quote: Tezzeret got the upper hand, infecting Jace with an etherium device
